questions.scenario: Your family is on a long road trip and the ultimate game of 'Antakshari' begins. What is your role?

options.A: Singing the loudest, taking the lead for your team, and acting like a superstar in the backseat.
options.B: Getting annoyed if the car speakers are crackling, and tweaking the bass/treble settings on the stereo.
options.C: Making up your own funny, rhyming lyrics on the spot when you forget the actual words to the song.
options.D: Making the strict rules, keeping the score, and ensuring the rival team isn't cheating.

questions.scenario: It is a boring free period. The backbenchers start making beats using steel tiffin boxes and pens. You...

options.A: Jump right in, start clapping loudly, and lead the rap or singing chorus to hype up the whole class.
options.B: Use exactly two pens and a geometry box to figure out how to get the absolute perfect 'snare' and 'kick drum' sound.
options.C: Start humming a completely brand-new, catchy melody over the random beat your friends are playing.
options.D: Act as the 'lookout', telling everyone exactly when to start and stop playing so the strict coordinator doesn't catch you.

questions.scenario: It's the grand School Annual Day Fest. Where can we find you during the musical performance?

options.A: Center stage! Holding the mic, wearing the flashiest outfit, and making the crowd go absolutely crazy.
options.B: Sitting behind the giant soundboard in the dark, making sure the mic doesn't screech and the music is crystal clear.
options.C: Sitting slightly off-center with your guitar, completely lost in playing the beautiful chords you arranged for the song.
options.D: Running backstage with a clipboard, making sure the band gets on stage exactly on time and the mics have batteries.

questions.scenario: You download a free music app (like BandLab) on your phone. What is the very first thing you do?

options.A: Hit record and instantly belt out your favorite Bollywood dance track at the top of your lungs.
options.B: Play with the equalizer, reverb, and autotune sliders for hours just to see how they change the texture of a voice.
options.C: Record a small, emotional 15-second poetry piece or piano tune you've had stuck in your head all day.
options.D: Figure out the 'Export' settings so you know exactly how to upload the final track to Instagram Reels or Spotify later.

questions.scenario: Let's talk about your daily 'Bathroom Singing' habits. What does your shower concert look like?

options.A: Using the showerhead as a microphone and performing a full live concert for an imaginary stadium of screaming fans.
options.B: Testing how the bathroom tiles create a natural 'echo' effect and trying to match frequencies with the exhaust fan.
options.C: Getting your best, most emotional song ideas while showering and rushing out quickly to write them in your diary.
options.D: Timing your shower concert perfectly. 2 songs for washing hair, 1 song for soap, so you don't miss the school bus.

questions.scenario: Your class is organizing the official Farewell party for the 12th Standard seniors. How do you contribute to the music?

options.A: Singing an emotional track like 'Yaaron' or 'Tera Yaar Hoon Main' on stage to make all the seniors cry.
options.B: Untangling 50 meters of messy black wires and setting up the heavy amplifiers so the sound doesn't cut off mid-song.
options.C: Writing a custom, original song that mentions all the funny inside jokes and memories of the senior batch.
options.D: Collecting the chanda (contribution money) to rent a proper drum kit and negotiating a discount with the music shop owner.

questions.scenario: You are watching a weekend singing reality show (like Indian Idol or Sa Re Ga Ma Pa) with your family. You are...

options.A: Standing up in the living room and trying to hit those tough, high-pitch notes right along with the contestants.
options.B: Complaining to your parents that the background track is way too loud and hiding the singer's actual vocal flaws.
options.C: Appreciating how beautifully the singer added their own unique 'harkat' (vocal variation) to a classic old song.
options.D: Predicting exactly which contestant will get the most audience votes based on their tragic backstory and stage presence.

questions.scenario: You hear a massive, trending viral song on an Instagram Reel. How does your brain process it?

options.A: You learn the lyrics instantly and practice singing it in front of the mirror to make your own energetic video.
options.B: You analyze the background beat, trying to isolate exactly which heavy bass synth or drum loop they used to make it catchy.
options.C: You feel deeply inspired by the mood of the song and grab your notebook to write a completely different, sad verse for it.
options.D: You mentally calculate how much royalty money and brand deals the creator must be making from millions of views.

questions.scenario: An uncle gifts you a brand new acoustic guitar or Casio keyboard for your birthday. What is your first reaction?

options.A: Learn three basic chords from YouTube immediately so you can start singing your favorite Arijit Singh song loudly.
options.B: Inspect the tuning pegs, the string action, and the technical specifications to check if the instrument is of high quality.
options.C: Turn off the room lights and pluck random strings/keys slowly, trying to invent a beautiful, original tune from scratch.
options.D: Think to yourself: 'If I practice hard and master this in 6 months, I can start playing paid gigs at the local cafe!'

questions.scenario: Your housing society is having a massive cultural night for Ganesh Chaturthi or Durga Puja. You...

options.A: Grab the mic during the open-mic session and absolutely rock the stage with a high-energy Bollywood dance number.
options.B: Stand next to the 'DJ waale bhaiya', telling him his treble is too sharp and helping him fix the speaker distortion.
options.C: Direct the smaller society kids on how to sing the complex, multi-layered vocal harmonies you arranged for the group bhajan.
options.D: Coordinate with the society secretary, finalize the artist line-up, and make sure the sound system vendors get paid on time.

Role_1.title: Live Performer / Lead Vocalist
Role_1.primary_match_text: You are the absolute star of the show! You have incredible energy, you love being the center of attention, and you have a natural gift for entertaining people and holding a crowd's attention.
Role_1.day_in_the_life: Doing daily 'riyaaz' (vocal practice), memorizing lyrics, dressing up in flashy outfits, traveling to different cities, and hyping up thousands of screaming fans from the stage.
Role_1.alternative_match_text: Your high confidence and commanding stage presence also make you a fantastic fit for Acting, Radio Jockeying (RJ), Public Speaking, or TV Anchoring.
Role_1.roadmap: Take any stream in 11th/12th. Start formal training in Indian Classical (Hindustani/Carnatic) or Western vocals immediately. Pursue a BPA (Bachelor of Performing Arts) in Music, and appear for Trinity College London vocal grade exams (widely available in India).

Role_2.title: Audio Engineer / Sound Mixer
Role_2.primary_match_text: You are the technical wizard behind the magic! You have a highly analytical brain and perfectly trained ears. You love software, buttons, frequencies, and making things sound absolutely perfect.
Role_2.day_in_the_life: Sitting in an acoustically treated dark studio, staring at complex software (like Pro Tools or Logic Pro), fixing bad vocals with auto-tune, and balancing the bass and treble for movie soundtracks.
Role_2.alternative_match_text: Your love for technology, software, and precision makes you an excellent fit for Software Testing, IT Management, or Acoustics Architecture.
Role_2.roadmap: Science (PCM) in 11th/12th is highly preferred for the physics of sound. Pursue a B.Sc or Diploma in Sound Engineering / Audiography from top Indian institutes like FTII (Pune), SRFTI (Kolkata), or SAE Institute. Mastering DAWs (Digital Audio Workstations) online is crucial.

Role_3.title: Music Composer / Lyricist
Role_3.primary_match_text: You are the creative soul of the music industry! You have a poetic mind and a deep imagination. Before a song becomes a hit, it starts inside your brain as a beautiful emotion, a written word, or a hummed melody.
Role_3.day_in_the_life: Waking up at 2 AM with a melody in your head, strumming the guitar to find the right chords, writing deep emotional lyrics, and composing background scores that make movie scenes feel magical.
Role_3.alternative_match_text: Your deep creativity and way with words also make you a brilliant candidate for Content Writing, Authoring, Copywriting, or Creative Direction.
Role_3.roadmap: Any stream in 11th/12th works perfectly. Pursue a BA in Music, Literature, or Mass Communication. Take Trinity College London grade exams in an instrument (Piano/Guitar). Focus heavily on building a strong portfolio of original compositions on YouTube or SoundCloud.

Role_4.title: Band Manager / Music Producer
Role_4.primary_match_text: You are the boss of the music business! You understand that talent alone isn't enough; it needs strategy, money, and management. You are a natural leader who knows how to turn a passion into a profitable career.
Role_4.day_in_the_life: Pitching your artists to big record labels, negotiating payments for live concerts, managing the budget for a music video shoot, and figuring out the algorithm to get maximum streams on Spotify.
Role_4.alternative_match_text: Your supreme organizational and leadership skills translate perfectly to Event Management, Digital Marketing, Public Relations (PR), or Entrepreneurship.
Role_4.roadmap: Commerce or Arts in 11th/12th. Pursue a BBA, B.Com, or BA in Mass Media. Follow it up with an MBA or a specialized Diploma in Music Business / Event Management from institutes like Whistling Woods International or AAFT. Networking in the local independent music scene is your biggest asset.
